contract.section: Unique metadata, one canonical, sitemap equality, one h1 and social coverage

titles.section: Best practices for influencing title links
titles.note: Retrieved 2026-10-22; no fixed character limit; display truncation depends on device width.

descriptions.section: Best practices for creating quality meta descriptions
descriptions.note: Retrieved 2026-10-22; no fixed character limit; descriptions should differ by page.

canonical.section: Use absolute paths; include canonical URLs in a sitemap

sitemap.section: XML tag definitions: loc; entity escaping
sitemap.note: Protocol 0.9; retrieved 2026-10-22. HTTPS and exact built-file equality are site policy, not protocol requirements.

robots.section: noindex and none; conflicting rules use the more restrictive rule

schema.note: Retrieved 2026-10-22. Schema.org is a vocabulary, not a universal required-property schema.

dataset.note: Description is between 50 and 5000 characters; creator is recommended, not required.

breadcrumb.note: At least two items; positions start at one; final item URL may be omitted; item.name can supply name.

og.note: Four required properties: title, type, image, url. Description is optional in the protocol and required by site policy. Arrays are allowed.

twitter.note: Retrieved 2026-10-22; redirects to a general documentation overview without card requirements. Completeness beyond the site's card-presence rule is not evaluated.
